component-o.description-s: TSER953 4.16-Gbps V3Link (FPD-Link III compatible) serializer with MIPI CSI-2 input (1-4 lanes, up to 832 Mbps/lane), coax or STP, I2C control, CLK_OUT for the image sensor; single 1.8 V supply; VQFN-32 5 x 5 mm.

layout_cites-o.coax_z_ohm_cite-s: p. 66 Table 8-2 Ztrace 45 / 50 / 55 ohm; p. 74 section 10.2: 'a 50-ohm single-ended micro-strip with tight impedance control (+-10%)'
layout_cites-o.coax_len_max_mm_cite-s: p. 66 Table 8-2 Ltrace: single-ended PCB trace length from the device pin to the connector pin, max 5 cm
layout_cites-o.coax_con_z_cite-s: p. 66 Table 8-2 Zcon: connector (mounted) characteristic impedance 40 / 50 / 60 ohm
layout_cites-o.coax_il_max_db_cite-s: p. 66 Table 8-2 insertion loss S12: f < 0.5 GHz -0.35 dB, f = 1 GHz -0.6 dB, f = 2.1 GHz -1.2 dB (PCB trace with the PoC network attached)
layout_cites-o.coax_rl_max_db_cite-s: p. 66 Table 8-2 return loss S11: 1/2 fBCC < f < 0.1 GHz -20 dB; 0.1-1 GHz -12 + 8 log(f); 1 GHz < f < fFC -12 dB. 1/2 fBCC = 25 MHz and fFC = 2.1 GHz for the 4.16 Gbps link with a 50 Mbps back channel (p. 64)
layout_cites-o.stp_zdiff_ohm_cite-s: p. 73 section 10.1: 'a differential impedance of 100 ohm is typically recommended for STP interconnect' (no tolerance stated)
layout_cites-o.pin_to_cap_cite-s: p. 65: 'Use coupled 100-ohm differential signal traces from the device pins to the AC-coupling caps. Use 50-ohm single-ended traces from the AC-coupling capacitors to the connector.'; p. 74: AC-coupling capacitors on the top layer, very close to the pins
layout_cites-o.ac_cap_nf_cite-s: p. 65 Figure 8-2: CAC1 (DOUT+) 33 nF to 100 nF, CAC2 (DOUT-) 15 nF to 47 nF
layout_cites-o.term_cite-s: p. 65: 'Terminate the inverting signal traces close to the connectors with standard 49.9-ohm resistors.' (Figure 8-2: DOUT- through CAC2 to 49.9 ohm)
layout_cites-o.poc_cite-s: p. 64: PoC network impedance >= 2 kohm from 1/2 fBCC to fFC (25 MHz to 2.1 GHz for this link); p. 65: keep the network current below 150 mA, smallest component (bead) closest to the connector with the trace through its pad, anti-pads under the pads; p. 74 the same
layout_cites-o.csi_zdiff_tol_pct_cite-s: p. 4 Table 5-1 (CSI_CLK, CSI_D pins): 'matched 100-ohm (+-5%) impedance interconnects'
layout_cites-o.csi_zdiff_tol_layout_pct_cite-s: p. 73 section 10.1.1: 'controlled 100-ohm differential impedance (+-20%) or 50-ohm single-ended impedance (+-15%)' -- the datasheet states both; the pin table's +-5 % is the tighter
layout_cites-o.csi_routing_cite-s: p. 73 section 10.1.1: length difference within a pair 5 mils, pairs separated by at least 3x the trace width, bends >= 135 degrees, all pairs on the same layer, two vias or fewer, adjacent to a ground plane, never over a plane split
layout_cites-o.layers_min_i_cite-s: p. 73 section 10.1: 'Use at least a four-layer board with a dedicated ground plane.'

cfgpins-ao.25c: No ferrite bead (Raul, 2026-10-15). klayout's rail-impedance study of the camera head: the BLM18KG102SN1D bead (~1.6 uH) resonates with 1 uF + 10 nF at ~0.13 MHz, |Z| 5.5-7 ohm whatever the placement; target 0.58 ohm (5 % of 1.8 V / 155 mA avdd max current) and 0.16 ohm from the datasheet's 25 mVp-p supply noise (SNLS696A 6.3 p7). Without the bead and with 10 uF + 1 uF + 2x100 nF + 10 nF at the pin, straight to the planes (datasheet 10.1 p73: smallest value closest to the pin, vias at both ends; X7R 0402/0603 rated >= 2x the supply), |Z| peaks 0.16 ohm in 10 kHz-50 MHz: meets both. TI's typical circuit shows a ferrite filter on pin 25; it is not kept. General rule: a series bead on a supply pin forms an L-C resonance with the pin's capacitors; keep one only if the bead's Z(f) and the caps meet the rail's target impedance across the band (klayout's PDN check judges it).

cfgpins-ao.8c: Power-down, active low, internal 1M pulldown, NOT 3.3 V tolerant. Tied up for power-on enable: 10k to VDD (1.8 V) and >1 uF to GND delays enable until the supplies settle (datasheet 8.x).

cfgpins-ao.21c: MODE strap 0 = CSI-2 synchronous (V3Link clock from the deserializer): RHIGH open, RLOW 10k (Table 7-8).

cfgpins-ao.19c: IDX strap 1 = I2C address 0x18 (7-bit), I2C at 1.8 V: RHIGH open, RLOW 40.2k (Table 7-9); >= 35k keeps CLK_OUT usable for the image sensor's EXTCLK.

cfgpins-ao.9c: PLL loop filter: 22 nF from LPF1 to VDDPLL (pin 11), smallest possible loop.

cfgpins-ao.12c: PLL loop filter: 100 nF from LPF2 to GND.

cfgpins-ao.20c: Reference clock input, only for non-synchronous external-clock mode; synchronous mode (MODE 0) leaves it open.

cfgpins-ao.14c: V3Link output: 33-100 nF (50 V X7R 0402) AC-coupling capacitor in series to the coax connector (Table 8-3); a series part to another component, not a pin passive.
